name: RECraft
description: Resident Evil 4 x Minecraft: Minecraft runs hidden and plays RE4 as Leon. One shared health with RE4, gear from RE4's merchant (weapons, tune-ups and attache case become Minecraft swords, axes, bow, armour and enchantments; ammo becomes arrows, herbs become steak), a wide sword sweep, blocks that stop RE4's enemies, RE4's rooms as solid Minecraft collision.
contributors: chasmlol - the original Minecraft link this mod grew from (MIT)
